data.long_description:
Experience luxury beachfront living in this spacious 2-bedroom apartment in Grand Bleu Tower 1, Emaar Beachfront. Offering 1576.48 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this unfurnished residence features breathtaking views of the open sea, private beach, and Palm Jumeirah from its expansive wraparound balcony.

Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the apartment with natural light, while the open-plan living and dining area creates a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The modern open kitchen comes fully fitted with a refrigerator, oven, and gas hob, making it ideal for everyday living. Both bedrooms feature built-in wardrobes, complemented by two well-appointed bathrooms.
